summary:
We developed an interactive video game inspired by space exploration, in which the player must travel through space and reach different celestial bodies while avoiding collisions with asteroids and other celestial objects that represent obstacles and dangers along the journey.

The project addresses NASA Space Apps Challenge's Space Mission Design Game challenge through a playful experience that recreates some of the challenges involved in carrying out a space mission, such as navigation, route planning, and decision-making to reach a destination.

This project is important because it aims to spark interest in exploring the universe and bring science and technology closer to people through video games. It also encourages the development of logical thinking, problem-solving, creativity, and computational thinking.
details:
We developed a space exploration video game in which the player must pilot a spacecraft to reach different celestial bodies while avoiding collisions with asteroids and other space objects.

The journey is organized according to the distance of each destination from Earth, starting with the closest ones and gradually moving toward more distant destinations. Each stage presents a new challenge that requires skill, anticipation, and decision-making.

The project aims to bring space exploration closer to people through a fun and interactive experience, sparking interest in the universe and space missions. It also promotes logical thinking, creativity, and problem-solving skills.

The video game was developed using Microsoft MakeCode Arcade, with block-based programming to design the scenarios, add characters and obstacles, control the spacecraft's movements, and program collisions and the conditions required to progress through the game.
